column2: Drag your finger up or down in the dark area to move the paddle. The ball bounces off the top, bottom, and right walls - each bounce plays a tick sound that pans in stereo from the right ear to the left. If the paddle intercepts the ball on the left, that's a hit and the ball speeds up each time. When the ball enters the left half heading for your paddle, you will hear a cheerful sound that gets louder until the hit. If the paddle is not in the ball's path, you will hear a low warning sound - the louder it is, the farther away the paddle is. Move the paddle until the cheerful sound comes back. If the ball gets past the paddle - the game ends. Try to get as many hits as you can!
